data.body: Fixed: check_would_create_cycle() in ticket_graph/_graph.py incorrectly used _get_all_blocked_by(target) for both 'blocks' and 'depends_on' relations. For 'depends_on', the cycle check must use _get_all_blocked_by(source) and check if target is in the result — not _get_all_blocked_by(target) checking for source. The prior code traversed depends_on edges backward, incorrectly treating A→C→B as a cycle when A→B was proposed. Fix: for relation=='depends_on', swap the lookup to _get_all_blocked_by(source_id) and check target_id in result. Two regression tests added to test_ticket_graph.py: test_check_would_create_cycle_no_false_positive_for_transitive_depends_on and test_add_dependency_allows_redundant_transitive_depends_on. All 49 existing tests continue to pass.
